architectureSummary: Unity WebGL 3D top-down hotel tycoon with CrazyGames SDK v3 (ads, cloud save, auth) and automated Blender 5.0 low-poly asset pipeline.

milestones.title: Foundation, PRDs & Contract Freeze
milestones.description: PRD, requirements, GDD, monetization guide, frozen contracts, and team orchestration scaffolding.

milestones.title: Core Gameplay, SDK Bridge & 3D Assets
milestones.description: C# GameManager & Player Controller, CrazyGames WebGL jslib bridge, and Blender 3D procedural models.
deliverables: TASK-002: CrazyGamesSDK.jslib, CrazyGamesSDK.cs, AdPlacementManager.cs, WebGL template
TASK-003: generate_brotel_models.py, 7 .obj models in Assets/Models/, PrefabsManifest.json

milestones.title: 5 Core Stations, Chaos Generator & Cloud Save
milestones.description: Interactive stations, chaos event controller, automated bro staff, and CrazyGames cloud save integration.
deliverables: TASK-004: ReceptionDesk, ProteinBar, SquatRack, BedSuite, SaunaZone stations
TASK-005: ChaosEventController.cs and StaffManager.cs (Bouncer, Barista, Sweeper)
TASK-006: CloudSaveManager.cs, User account sync, UI banner integration

milestones.title: WebGL Build, Testing & CrazyGames Submission
milestones.description: Unity CLI WebGL compilation, AdBlock verification, size audit (<25MB), and release packaging.
deliverables: Clean WebGL build passing quality checks
Submission package ready for CrazyGames portal
